comment: Professor Leonard is an amazing professor. Shes an easy grader and gives lots of good feedback. Ive taken her for two different classes and I wish she taught more that I needed because I would 100% take her again
Prof Leonard is great. She didn't give any homework or extra work outside of two exams in Intro to the Judicial System, and both exams had an option to retake.
If you are having difficulty with something, just talk to her and she will work  it out with you
